item.title: Soulslinger: Envoy of Death coming to PS5, Xbox Series on February 19
item.description: Publisher Headup Games and developer Elder Games will release Wild West-themed roguelite first-person shooter Soulslinger: Envoy of Death for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series on February 19, the companies announced.

item.title: Lelu Developer Responds to Player Feedback as Q2 2026 Release Window Confirmed
item.description: Get your gears in motion for a captivating monochromatic adventure where you play as Lelu, a small but determined clockwork toy who has gained consciousness and found a taste for freedom!

item.title: Ubisoft Cancels Prince of Persia Sands of Time Remake
item.description: Ubisoft has canceled the Prince of Persia Sands of Time remake alongside five other projects, while delaying seven games as part of a major restructuring.

item.title: Terra Invicta Review | NoobFeed
item.description: Sarwar from NoobFeed writes: Terra Invictas biggest problem is also its biggest power. It doesnt give in. It thinks you want depth, complexity, and effects that last for a long time. Even though tutorials describe mechanics, you have to try things out, fail, and be patient to really get good at them.

item.title: The Killing Stone Drops A Reveal Trailer
item.description: A trailer for the pending game has been revealed.

item.title: Final Fantasy VII Intergrade (Switch 2) Review - Portable, Powerful, Phenomenal | COGconnected
item.description: Can Final Fantasy VII Remake retain its ambition and impact on Nintendos hybrid console, or does the weight of Midgar prove too much?

item.title: Final Fantasy VII Remake Intergrade Switch 2 Review - Twisted Voxel
item.description: A technical miracle for hybrid hardware, this port leverages DLSS to outshine its PS4 predecessor with striking fidelity.

item.title: The Legend of Heroes: Trails Beyond the Horizon Alignment Guide
item.description: Find out how the Alignment system works in The Legend of Heroes: Trails Beyond the Horizon, using this guide.

item.title: Final Fantasy VII Remake Intergrade Review (Switch 2) | Hey Poor Player
item.description: HPP: Final Fantasy VII Remake Intergrade offers a fantastic journey on the Switch 2 which is a must play for anyone who still hasnt been able to dive into this modern take on an all-time classic. It comfortably sits among the most impressive experiences Ive had on Nintendos latest system thus far.

item.title: Death Stranding Director's Cut is now available on Xbox game pass across PC and console
item.description: "KOJIMA PRODUCTIONS and 505 Games are proud to announce that DEATH STRANDING DIRECTORS CUT, the definitive version of Hideo Kojimas Genre-Defying Epic, is now available for Xbox Game Pass across PC and console, only for subscribers on the Xbox Game Pass Premium and Ultimate tiers." - KOJIMA PRODUCTIONS and 505 Games.
